blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — An official of the Department of Energy (DOE) is seeking court permission to travel abroad amid an ongoing graft case against him. Demujin Antiporda, director IV of the energy resources development bureau under the DOE, filed a motion to allow travel before the Sandiganbayan Third Division by email on Sept. 29. He is a co-accused of former Energy Secretary Alfonso Cusi in his graft case regarding the sale of shares in the Malampaya gas project in 2019.
